sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At the core of Feed the Fox is the gameplay mechanic of collecting chicks while avoiding bombs. The game is played on a single-screen arena where the fox is located at the bottom, and the chicks and bombs fall from the top. The player must use the arrows on the screen or the keyboard arrows to move the fox left or right, and jump to avoid the bombs. The chicks can be collected by touching them with the fox, and the player earns points for each chick collected. The game also features a scoring system where the player earns bonus points for collecting multiple chicks in a row.

The gameplay mechanics are simple yet challenging, making it accessible to players of all ages and skill levels. The game also features a power-up system where the player can earn temporary invincibility or increased speed to help them navigate the arena. The game also features a leaderboard system where players can compete with each other to achieve the highest score. Overall, the core gameplay mechanics of Feed the Fox make it a game that is sure to challenge and entertain players of all ages.
